TEMPTATION ||| Press the Answer into his palm, daring him to respond. ||| "Let them see how aligned we really are, Julian."  
BOUNDARY ||| Pull my hands away from his grip, reclaiming my space. ||| "I can't answer your questions under this pressure."  
CONFESSION ||| Meet his gaze, letting my truth spill out. ||| "I can't stop thinking about what you've done."  
REVERSAL ||| Stand tall, shifting the momentum in my favor. ||| "I won’t let you control this moment any longer."  
SILENCE ||| Hold the Answer tightly, letting the weight anchor me. ||| *A slow, shaky breath.*
